purpose: Select exactly one economically distinct offline three-session factor after terminal Campaign078, before opening any Campaign079 daily source row, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

definition_only_source_boundary.source: accepted local point-in-time daily provider field daily_basic.turnover_rate or its canonical raw equivalent
forbidden_before_protocol_and_implementa: Candidate49 historical values or ledger additions

candidate_design_catalog.reason: The provider's raw signal-day turnover-rate percentage measures how much of the tradable share base changed hands, a whole-session attention/intensity mechanism not represented by normalized intraday profile shapes.
Log, winsorization, clipping, or embedded ranking would create transform choices; the audit and development engine already apply the frozen directional cross-sectional rank.
Lag windows and change operators create a parameter family and a same-campaign rescue path.
Absolute activity mixes firm size and nominal price; provider turnover_rate is selected as the direct tradable-share intensity field.
Neutralization, peer residualization, filters, thresholds, subsets, fitting, models, and combinations are outside this one-factor campaign.

selected_candidate.name: signal_day_turnover_rate_pct
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A larger fraction of the tradable share base changing hands on the signal day can reflect broad attention and ownership transfer that persists into the next three sessions.
selected_candidate.formula: Use the accepted provider's raw signal-session turnover_rate percentage exactly once for the same symbol and accepted trade date; no reconstruction, lag, transform, clipping, neutralization, or embedded rank.
selected_candidate.availability: Known after the signal-session close from the accepted daily_basic-equivalent field; entry remains the next accepted session open t+1.
selected_candidate.missing_rule: Missing when the canonical symbol-date-provider identity is absent or duplicated, the provider/source identity is not accepted, or turnover_rate is nonfinite or negative. Never fill suspended/missing rows with zero and never infer the denominator from volume.

decision.required_next_step: Complete and bind one exhaustive no-value mechanism-overlap audit; only then freeze the exact no-return protocol, code, tests, and implementation fingerprints before any daily source or candidate value.
